title: hackelia scaberrima
intro: Hackelia scaberrima, commonly known as stickseed, is a plant species that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is a perennial herb native to North America, valued for its potential health benefits and medicinal properties. The stickseed plant is reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Hackelia scaberrima include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
